author: PlaysByBrulesRules
body:
They spawn in the forest biome. If you find yourself near a patch of tree textured map, then pop a torch and equip any monster spawn items you have like lasting lanterns. 

Kill stuff around there for a minute and they’ll start to spawn

author: permaculturegeek
body:
A pursuance amity (increased spawn of any monster required for a quest) is really useful for your world load out. My only gripe is that they don't work on mobs which are daily goals.
The amity might well turn up in monumental guild during this event (I finally got memory reward amities by buying them).
